fields.text: The White Temple keeps the Lamb as a secret. It is called the Lamb because it was born of a sheep, and it is a holy child of Vandoh. Eluding it comprises the first half of the adventure.
fields.title: The Lamb

fields.text: A decade ago, the Twelve-Fingered Hand, a militia and brotherhood of knights closely aligned with the White Temple, attacked the Red Temple and attempted to infiltrate through the crypts. The Hand failed; many were killed, many were entombed, and some are now ghouls.
fields.title: The Raid

fields.first_impression: The Jewel of the Plains, renowned for freedom and lawlessness. Three great temples hold power, and all three are corrupt and unsympathetic.
